
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Javaer1995/p/20087155" title="发布于 2026-11-15 20:26">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Windows 环境下安装 Node.js</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="1下载">1、下载</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>官网下载地址：<a href="https://nodejs.org/en/download" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://nodejs.org/en/download</a></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202605/2052479-20260519232900411-1783232891.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如上图所示，选择最新 LTS 版本的 Windows Installer 下载。</p>
<h2 id="2安装">2、安装</h2>
<h3 id="21运行安装程序">2.1、运行安装程序</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202605/2052479-20260519234053253-1218124924.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="22开始安装向导">2.2、开始安装向导</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202605/2052479-20260519234155747-1393400432.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="23同意许可协议">2.3、同意许可协议</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202605/2052479-20260519234301589-1197338561.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="24设置安装目录">2.4、设置安装目录</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202605/2052479-20260519234603045-38387777.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如上图所示，本例使用默认安装目录。</p>
<h3 id="25选择安装组件">2.5、选择安装组件</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202605/2052479-20260519234801478-1744688299.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如上图所示，本例安装默认组件。</p>
<h3 id="26跳过-c-编译模块">2.6、跳过 C++ 编译模块</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202605/2052479-20260519235447372-962411669.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如上图所示，本例默认不安装 C++ 编译模块，因为这个模块太大且没必要。</p>
<h3 id="27开始安装">2.7、开始安装</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202605/2052479-20260519235634645-76391601.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="28完成安装">2.8、完成安装</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202605/2052479-20260519235742385-1879482792.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="3安装后检查">3、安装后检查</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202605/2052479-20260520000004753-98539271.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如上图所示，可以在 cmd 窗口中查询到版本号。</p>
<pre><code>node -v
</code></pre>
<pre><code>npm -v
</code></pre>
<h2 id="4配置国内镜像源">4、配置国内镜像源</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202605/2052479-20260521013851212-551381249.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如上图所示，执行该命令即可配置为国内的 npm 镜像源。</p>
<pre><code>npm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2052479/202605/2052479-20260521014024599-1127926348.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如上图所示，执行该命令即可确认镜像源是否配置成功。</p>
<pre><code>npm config get registry
</code></pre>
